description: Use when an agent must check a dependency before installing or upgrading: is this exact package version vulnerable? Input: package, ecosystem (npm, PyPI, Go, Maven, crates.io, NuGet, RubyGems, Packagist...), version. Output: JSON vulnerable yes/no, counts by severity, advisories (GHSA/CVE id, summary, severity, CVSS, CWE, fixed versions, links). Data: OSV.dev. Example: ?package=lodash&ecosystem=npm&version=4.17.15 Price: $0.003 USDC via x402.

ecosystem.description: Package ecosystem (case-insensitive; pip/python, cargo/rust, composer, gem also accepted)

package.description: Package name as in its registry (Go: module path; Maven: group:artifact)

name: package_vulnerabilities
title: Open-source package vulnerabilities: package@version to CVEs, severity, fixed versions
